review_type: Targeted evidence review, not exhaustive systematic review
primary_sources: arXiv for two explicitly labeled supplements

papers.label: STAPO
papers.title: STAPO: Selective Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.evidence: 1.5B：GRPO SR56.8%，完整STAPO69.0%；同状态熵归一化与选择性信用分配。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1/3，PDF第6–7页。完整方法不是单独换熵阈值；3B结果是QA。

papers.label: CRPS
papers.title: CRPS: Curriculum Replay via Progressive Suffixes from Successful Trajectories for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第7页。需要中间状态恢复；无3B直接证据，表中无误差条。

papers.label: ATLAS
papers.title: ATLAS: Agent Tuning via Learning Critical Steps
papers.evidence: 关键步骤SFT：Llama SR68→71.5；Qwen7B却由65.5降至62.5。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1/2及附录表7。不能宣称关键步骤SFT普遍优于全轨迹。

papers.label: AgentTuning
papers.title: AgentTuning: Enabling Generalized Agent Abilities for LLMs
papers.evidence: 筛选成功轨迹并混通用指令；7B平均reward由4.4到63.6。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表3及表5。63.6不是成功率；旧框架版本影响复现。

papers.label: AgentGym / AgentSTaR
papers.title: AgentGym: Evaluating and Training Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments
papers.evidence: 成功探索后迭代训练：初始SFT SR66.5，大数据SFT73.5，自训练76.5。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表3，第6页。包含额外探索和训练；不是GRPO。

papers.label: Agent-FLAN
papers.title: Agent-FLAN: Designing Data and Methods of Effective Agent Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.evidence: 对齐聊天格式、能力配比及负样本；可用于设计SFT数据。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2/6。没有单独WebShop增益，不能搬用跨任务均值。

papers.label: AgentRM
papers.title: AgentRM: Enhancing Agent Generalization with Reward Modeling
papers.evidence: 任务SFT策略平均reward：greedy61.4，Best-of-5为71.0，beam为75.3。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2/8。需要推理RM及搜索；数值不是SR。

papers.label: SoftSC
papers.title: Soft Self-Consistency Improves Language Models Agents
papers.evidence: 按token概率重排候选，SR greedy16.0→SoftSC(k10)24.6。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，50题。是推理多采样收益，不是小模型参数学习。

papers.label: MMR-GRPO
papers.title: MMR-GRPO: Accelerating GRPO-Style Training through Diversity-Aware Reward Reweighting
papers.evidence: 按语义多样性重加权；7B更早达峰，1.5B没有加速。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第7页。无WebShop；不是删除重复落盘记录。

papers.label: ETO
papers.title: Trial and Error: Exploration-Based Trajectory Optimization of LLM Agents
papers.evidence: SFT后做探索偏好训练：SR33.0→37.5；reward63.1→67.4。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2、附录表7。先SFT3epoch，再两轮探索/DPO；无SFT直接ETO会退化。

papers.label: T²PO
papers.title: T²PO: Uncertainty-Guided Exploration Control for Stable Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 4B完整SR81.64；去RFT61.32；控制思考长度与停滞重采样。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1/3/4。非Qwen2.5；评测是否关闭控制器未核明。

papers.label: Early Experience
papers.title: Agent Learning via Early Experience
papers.evidence: 7B：raw GRPO SR64.8；IL+GRPO84.4；IWM+GRPO91.4。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表5，第20页。额外1571人类轨迹和真实后继数据；不能当等总成本。

papers.label: HiPER
papers.title: HiPER: Hierarchical Plan–Execute RL for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
papers.evidence: 7B GiGPO SR75.2→HiPER83.3；对子目标和动作分层分配优势。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第9页。增加critic和输出协议；部分基线外引。

papers.label: QLASS
papers.title: QLASS: Boosting Language Agent Inference via Q-Guided Stepwise Search
papers.evidence: Q引导搜索score70.3；将搜索结果用于自训练时，score63.1→66.4。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2及图4。200题、5步；主表依赖搜索和额外QNet，不是SR。

papers.label: LATS
papers.title: Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models
papers.evidence: 树搜索score75.9、SR38.0；两者不可互换。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表6，第8页。免参数更新，增加分支、估值和反思调用。

papers.label: LAC / Actor-Critic
papers.title: Enhancing Decision-Making of Large Language Models via Actor-Critic
papers.evidence: 候选动作的GOOD/BAD概率和未来预测用于推理重加权。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 附录表3/4。无3B；多候选和世界预测有额外成本。

papers.label: ArCHer
papers.title: ArCHer: Training Language Model Agents via Hierarchical Multi-Turn RL
papers.evidence: 动作级off-policy价值与token级策略学习结合，使用经验回放。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 图4及附录A/C。100题快速子集、10步；没有可直接引用的最终SR。

papers.label: EMPG
papers.title: Harnessing Uncertainty: Entropy-Modulated Policy Gradients for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.evidence: 7B GRPO SR65.6→69.3；用动作熵与终奖调整梯度。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第7页。低熵动作可获得更强正负更新；组件消融非WebShop。

papers.label: WebShop原论文
papers.title: WebShop: Towards Scalable Real-World Web Interaction with Grounded Language Agents
papers.limitation_and_locator: 图4，第8页。直接反例：连续分数上升不保证完全成功率上升。

papers.label: Reflexion
papers.title: Reflexion: language agents with verbal reinforcement learning
papers.evidence: 100个环境、至多4次尝试，原作者未观察到WebShop改善。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 附录B.1，第14页。反思记忆不更新参数；应保留负面证据。

papers.label: ExpeL
papers.title: ExpeL: LLM Agents Are Experiential Learners
papers.evidence: 从成功/失败提炼规则并检索案例；研究规则与案例的不同作用。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 第5.2节。推理读取经验；迁移为训练文档后仍需验证裸模型。

papers.label: AutoGuide
papers.title: AutoGuide: Automated Generation and Selection of Context-Aware Guidelines for Large Language Model Agents
papers.evidence: 状态相关指南：ReAct SR30→46；同文另有更多示例对照。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1/3仅核官方PDF索引。完整PDF未打开；原方法推理使用指南。

papers.label: WKM
papers.title: Agent Planning with World Knowledge Model
papers.evidence: 任务知识与状态知识分别帮助决策；完整方法Mistral score65.48。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1及图3。额外知识模型与检索；不是65.48% SR。

papers.label: GiGPO
papers.title: Group-in-Group Policy Optimization for LLM Agent Training
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第8页。同批相同状态分组，无额外critic；3B是QA实验。

papers.label: SHADOW
papers.title: SHADOW: Dynamic-Aware Credit Assignment Against Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.evidence: 动态感知分组：该文1.5B GiGPO SR71.4→76.6；7B76.3→81.5。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第5页。这些是该文基线，不与GiGPO原表混算。

papers.label: ActRe
papers.title: When Instinct Guides and Insight Grounds: Staged RL Training for LLM Agents
papers.evidence: 1.5B GRPO SR57→64；只升全局温度却为56。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2，第6页。完整方法是两阶段动作/思考训练，非只调温度。

papers.label: DEPO
papers.title: DEPO: Dual-Efficiency Preference Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.evidence: BC+KTO→DEPO：SR54→56；报告token886→726。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1，第5页。3B只是未训练基线；含教师MCTS、BC和偏好训练。

papers.label: Step-level Q Models
papers.title: Enhancing Decision-Making for LLM Agents via Step-Level Q-Value Models
papers.evidence: Phi3的平均reward0.30→0.61；每一步对多个动作评分。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表2，第6页。不是61% SR；100题、10步，增加推理模型。

papers.label: DAPO
papers.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale
papers.evidence: 动态采样、非对称clip、token损失和超长处理组成训练配方。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1为逐项累积实验。无WebShop；各项增益不可直接独立相加。

papers.label: LUFFY
papers.title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
papers.evidence: 混合外部推理轨迹与自身rollout，并处理行为策略差异。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 附录E.2表3有1.5B结果。无WebShop；不是直接复制教师轨迹。

papers.label: UFT
papers.title: UFT: Unifying Supervised and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.evidence: 平滑缩短提示前缀，并联合监督与强化学习。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 第3.1.1节。不是仅减小指导比例；无WebShop实验。

papers.label: Beyond the 80/20 Rule
papers.title: Beyond the 80/20 Rule: High-Entropy Minority Tokens Drive Effective Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning
papers.evidence: 只更新高熵20% token；8B近似保持效果，更大模型收益较强。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 第2–4节。梯度mask与当前文档引导采样是不同方法。

papers.label: SEED〔预印本〕
papers.title: SEED: Self-Evolving On-Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.venue: arXiv 2026; not verified as a paper in the four requested venues
papers.evidence: 同文GRPO SR63.3→SEED78.9；训练后撤掉Skill。
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1。先训练事后技能分析，再联合RL/监督；非四会议已核收录。

papers.label: UOPD〔预印本〕
papers.title: UOPD: Uncertainty-Aware Intervention for On-Policy Distillation of Multi-Turn Agents
papers.venue: arXiv 2026; not verified as a paper in the four requested venues
papers.limitation_and_locator: 表1/2。置信度选干预并监督纠正动作；非四会议已核收录。
